owner_instruction: Further propose and implement improvements grounded in concrete cases and requirements until a measured development loop can be closed; do not fabricate positive effects
scope: A new exploratory development study after known negative studies; frozen before new model calls. No final TEST/tag. Additional independent GAGA surrogate knowledge is explicit.
resource_selection: Teacher runs on CPU with CUDA visibility empty. Before any baseline generation, choose first registered GPU with >=8192MiB free, else CPU; bind one device for preflight/all3seeds/evaluation. Never interrupt other jobs or compare new CPU baseline with old GPU predictions as paired.

teacher_data_scope.labels: Only original TRAIN6595 labels fit the new classifier. Former TUNE is now TRAIN; post-refit TRAIN metrics are in-sample.
teacher_data_scope.inputs: Existing full-TRAIN seven-token sequence/group conventions; original features and graph are transductive.
teacher_data_scope.initialization: Same independently seeded random constructor as prior fresh GAGA, never old fitted teacher or victim weights
teacher_data_scope.horizon: 38terminalepochs chosen from prior internal-only selection before this study; no new VALID selection

method.base: All3previous legacy-GCN terminal8 generators, not bestseedselection; one new baseline hardgraph per seed/group is shared by all5branches
method.legal_features: Continuous original per-coordinate min/max box, zero-width coordinates fixed. Normalize u=(x-min)/(max-min), projected sign-gradient descent20steps alpha.02. No additional small-Lp guarantee or semantic article realization is claimed.
method.objective: Mean numerically stable Softplus(logit_fraud-logit_benign) on fixed hard graph; no topology/edge gradients
method.gaga_sequence: Exact affine dependence on injected features at fixed topology; all newly reachable original-node constants retained. Validate hard-update/logit parity and feature derivatives.
method.random: One seeded Rademacher direction held for20steps, same step bound/box. Actual displacement/saturation can differ after clipping and are reported; no claim of equal terminal movement.
method.guard: Terminal GAGA candidate accepted for whole group only if every target classified0by baseline original-GCN remains0under candidate; otherwise baselinefeatures. Original GCN predictions only, no official victim or evaluation-label selection. No guarantee on official GAGA.
method.checkpoint_selection: Always terminal20; no best iterate, retries, extra epochs, seed additions or validation-selected examples
unchanged: baseline generator weights and original h_GCN
candidate policy and the single shared captured hardgraph
original source-score role and native ties

preflight.finite_difference_registration: GAGA retains original float32 h=.001 check on interior u=.5 top4nonzero raw-margin coordinates and actual Softplus when nonzero. GCN uses the separately registered fixed-block float64 five-level convergence and activation-branch check on coordinates chosen by actual float32 raw-margin gradient. All four fixed TRAIN cases retained; no victim or optimizer work.
preflight.gcn_derivative_amendment: Freeze one sampled block/NID/EID/local-arc order. Same frozen float32 weights copied to float64 only for functional differentiation. Original gradient tolerances apply to actual float32 versus float64 autograd and float64 finite differences. All five h measured; finest two must pass both objectives and preserve both LeakyReLU sign patterns. No first-passing-step choice; actual float32 feature PGD unchanged.

evaluation.primary: gaga_guarded minus baseline official-GAGA occurrence MR on complete128VALIDgroups, higher strongerattack
secondary: all group-equal and fixed budget summaries
evaluation.closure_rule: Functional/provenance/legality checks pass; own GAGA mean group Softplus strictly decreases in each of3seeds; primary mean >=1pp and all3 pairedseed deltas >0 versus baseline, plus positive mean advantage versusGCNPGDandrandom. Report n3 conditional t95 regardless; interval crossing0 remains uncertainty, no general efficacy claim.
evaluation.no_forced_winner: Retain everyarm/seed/case, failures, fallback and negatives. Secondary improvements are labeled secondary, not a replacement primary.
evaluation.gcn_channel: Fresh128clean originalGCNforwards; attackedGCNpredictions reuse exactstoredrefinementlogits bound to eachcapture/features, not independentfreshreplay
evaluation.prespecified_secondary_candidate: If primaryguardfails its frozen criterion but unguardedGAGAfeaturePGD meets the same baseline/control criterion, report a prespecified secondary development candidate, not primary confirmation; fullTESTconfirmation remains separate.

failure_rule: Stop on failure with immutable unique directories and all partial counters/time; no automatic reruns or outcome-driven tuning within this comparison.
